title: gj-gameplay: research handbook (RESOURCES.md + SKILLS.md)
summary: First task before any ticket (kit §3 common block): research the top 100 resources on climbing and parkour systems (Assassin's Creed, Zelda BotW/TotK, Mirror's Edge talks), character controller feel (Celeste, Mario Odyssey, Astro Bot), Unity 6 URP mobile performance, splat rendering integration, procedural animation, audio middleware on mobile; save an annotated list and distill a working handbook. Re-read SKILLS.md at every session start and update it when you learn something.

acceptance_tests.test: projects/skills/gameplay/RESOURCES.md lists at least 100 resources, each with title, URL, type (doc / paper / talk / repo / postmortem / vendor guide), and a one-line 'why it matters for GJ', grouped by the role's research focus.
acceptance_tests.evidence: file in PR; Coordinator counts entries

acceptance_tests.test: projects/skills/gameplay/SKILLS.md covers: the five-layer movement architecture (Bible §2), verb implementation order, motion matching and warping pipeline (Bible §12–13), camera rules (§8), Tier 0/1 runtime, the 30 fps budget; plus mistakes to avoid and the checklists you run before opening a PR.

SKILLS.md cites the repo rules it must follow (agents/grok/README.md, REVIEW_RUBRIC.md, SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md) and, where the role touches them, the Movement Bible and Design Skills sections by number.
SKILLS.md ends with a `## Session log` section (date, what was learned, what changed) that later sessions append to.
Branch is `setup/gameplay-skills`, the PR uses the template, secret-scan and lint are green, and no vendor keys or account details appear.
